title: Quetta Traffic Fumes Surge

title: Islamabad Smog Increase

title: Peshawar Smog Elevation
why_it_matters: Persistent upward smog trend in the Peshawar basin with elevated risks for respiratory hospital admissions.

title: Multan Traffic Fumes Reduction

title: Peshawar Rainfall Drying Trend

title: Quetta Haze Decline
why_it_matters: Long-term reduction in high-altitude haze (aerosol light extinction) over the western valley.
